visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of a small, irregularly shaped snowman built in a snowy field. A hand in a black glove points at the snowman's face, which features small brown seeds for eyes and a twig for hair. The background is a dense park with tall, leafless trees and a deep layer of white snow under bright daylight. (2) Cut to a medium shot of a man wearing a black beanie and a white winter jacket with a green and tan panel across the chest. He stands in the snowy park, gesturing with his hands as he speaks to someone off-camera. His facial expression is animated and smiling. (3) The camera returns to the snowman, showing a wider angle that includes the misshapen legs of the snow figure. The gloved hand continues to point at different parts of the sculpture. (4) The camera focuses back on the man, who is now laughing heartily with his head tilted back. He then leans forward, pulls out a smartphone, and prepares to take a photo of his creation. His breath is visible in the cold air.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 我的時扁頭人. (2) [Subtitle]: 頭髮燙海嘛 眼睛. (3) [Subtitle]: 然後它的 頭髮只有一根喔. (4) [Subtitle]: 象徵性的 腳都還有做出來喔. (5) [Subtitle]: 我的觀眾有可能也會喜歡這種怪的. (6) [Subtitle]: 因為我好歹也是 圖文作家. (7) [Subtitle]: 以前是圖文作家. (8) [Subtitle]: 圖文作家做出這個雪人. (9) [Subtitle]: 這是圖文作家做出來的 (比較2D一點?). (10) [Subtitle]: 難怪後來改講笑話. (11) [Subtitle]: 不~~~. (12) [Subtitle]: 我要跟它合照 它那麼棒.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A cheerful male voice introduces his 'flat-headed person' snowman with high vocal energy and a bright pitch. Background music featuring a playful flute and light percussive hits begins immediately. (2) A female voice laughs off-camera, her laughter featuring high spectral brightness. The male voice shifts to a self-deprecating but comedic tone, speaking at a fast pace about his past as an illustrator. (3) As the female voice mockingly repeats his former profession, the male voice breaks into a high-arousal, loud laugh. The BGM remains consistent in tempo and volume. (4) The male voice playfully yells 'No~~~' with a wide pitch contour, followed by a lighter conversational tone expressing his admiration for the snowman as the track fades.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Object Introduction -> Background Context -> Climax/Laughter -> Resolution.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To create a humorous moment by showcasing a poorly made snowman and contrasting it with the creator's former identity as a graphic illustrator, highlighting the irony through laughter and banter.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses subtitles to emphasize the comedic dialogue. The contrast between the simple, '2D' snowman and the man's claim to be an illustrator provides the central joke.
